image_preprocessing: EXIF transpose; RGBA white composite; RGB; Lanczos contain; white 280x280 centered letterbox; PNG
reference_selection: Per-class medoid: original public-pretrained DINO features, float64 row L2 normalization, original training-class normalized centroid, maximum cosine, numeric-ID tie-break; duplicate reference groups excluded

prompts.expert: Identify which provider rendered the query emoji image. Classify the visual rendering style/provider, not the emoji's meaning. The seven labelled reference images are examples from the training data; they may depict different emoji contents and are not exhaustive descriptions of a provider. Facebook and Messenger are distinct dataset labels. Select exactly one allowed provider.
prompts.final: Make the final provider classification for the query emoji image. Classify its visual rendering style/provider, not its meaning. The state includes the full seven-class probability distributions of DINOv2, ConvNeXt, and a separate image-only Jev pass. Treat all three as fallible evidence together with the image and labelled training references; select the provider best supported by that evidence. Reference images may depict different emoji contents. Facebook and Messenger are distinct dataset labels. Select exactly one allowed provider.

router: Use final Jev only where DINOv2 and ConvNeXt top labels disagree; otherwise exact baseline probabilities
development_order: All original model disagreements first, then agreements; each segment deterministically shuffled without labels
evaluation_warning: REUSED development set used in earlier model selection; results are exploratory and not an unbiased final-test score. Pilot is training data and is for integration/cost checks only.
paired_p: exact two-sided binomial, descriptive only; no significance claim
ai_usage: AI generated experiment code and prompt text. Students must write their own course report and disclose prompts/code assistance.
